title: Getting a mortgage for an apartment in Dushanbe: rates and checks
excerpt: Published somoni terms from three banks and checks to make before applying. Reviewed on 15 October 2026; approval and final terms are determined by the bank.
contentHtml:
Substantively updated on 15 October 2026.

Start with your budget and the bank’s requirements for the particular apartment. Compare the down payment, loan limit and term together: a low advertised interest rate alone does not establish the total purchase cost.

Examples of published somoni terms

The table covers individual programs, not national average rates or the entire market. The figures were read on official pages on 15 October 2026. Ask each lender for the current tariff, repayment schedule, total cost and applicable additional charges.

The linked Alif page also lists a guarantor requirement and separate conditions for replacing the down payment with collateral. A dash means that a limit was not carried over from this source, not that there is no limit. Terms may change after the review date.

Working out the loan amount

Subtract the personal funds available for the down payment from the apartment price, keeping a reserve for closing costs and unexpected expenses. Compare the balance with the program’s maximum loan. If the balance exceeds that limit, meeting the minimum down-payment percentage is not enough. Do not count an expected property sale or future income as money already received.

Check the property before paying a deposit

Ask whether the bank accepts the selected property as security: a completed apartment or that particular building under construction. Obtain the required property and seller document list from the lender. Checking a developer involves more than viewing a QR-code photo: compare the legal entity, building, documents and contract terms. Until the bank accepts the property, do not treat the loan as agreed.

Compare the other costs

Request separate amounts for valuation, insurance, bank fees, notarisation and registration where they apply to your transaction. Ask about early repayment, payment changes and late-payment consequences. Compare offers in the same currency and over comparable terms. A foreign-currency loan adds uncertainty when your income is in somoni.

Practical order of steps

Set a budget and shortlist apartments, obtain the lender’s requirements, check the property and documents, then compare written calculations. Read the schedule and agreement again before signing. ROYAL HOME can arrange a viewing from its catalog; the bank decides whether to lend.
